title: Can I MASTER Crazyhouse Chess?
summary: chess.com Crazyhouse against online humans (~1460-1490 early, a 1900 at the end): captured pieces switch colour and go to the capturer's pocket, from where they can be dropped onto any empty square as a move. Goal: win five games, playing more aggressively than last time. He wins games 1-5 by opening lines around the enemy king and dropping pieces, then plays a bonus game 6 vs a 1900 and loses to a queen-drop mate.
rules: Standard start and normal chess moves.
A captured piece changes colour and goes into the capturer's pocket (reserve).
On your turn you may instead drop one pocket piece onto any EMPTY square (cannot drop on top of a piece, 5:17).
Pawns cannot be dropped on the 1st or 8th rank; a promoted piece returns to the pocket as a pawn when captured (standard crazyhouse rules, inferred).
Drops may give check or checkmate (standard crazyhouse, inferred).
win_condition: Checkmate/resign/time. Series goal: 5 wins (achieved in 5; lost bonus game 6).

opponent.name: Online humans (e.g. kastet2, TreChill999; final game a 1900)
opponent.avatar_description: Generic chess.com human avatars; remake: silhouettes, ~1450-1500 with a stronger 1900 bonus opponent.
